testimonials.title: Reviews
testimonials.description: Professionals and athletes who trust BIOMSTEP.

items.quote: I've been using the running insoles for two seasons and the difference is huge. I used to finish 10k runs with my right foot in agony — now I finish strong. I'd never race without them.
items.author: Laura M.

items.quote: I've been using the anatomical models in my practice for eight months. Patients understand plantar fasciitis so much better when they can see and touch the structure. Treatment adherence has improved noticeably.
items.author: Dr. Javier García

items.quote: I work twelve-hour shifts on my feet in a kitchen. Within the first month with BIOMSTEP insoles I stopped coming home with burning calves. My physio asked what had changed.
items.author: Carlos R.

items.quote: I'm a sports physiotherapist and recommend BIOMSTEP to my overpronating athletes consistently. The results are reliable and the professional support is excellent.
items.author: Marta S.

items.quote: I was diagnosed with heel spur a year ago. With the orthopaedic insoles and my podiatrist's guidance I improved in six weeks. The morning pain on first steps has nearly disappeared.
items.author: Antonio V.

items.quote: I train triathlon and the insoles hold up perfectly through the bike-to-run transition. No odd pressure points and they fit well in different shoes.
items.author: Nerea P.

items.quote: I have severe flat feet and tried several brands before finding BIOMSTEP. It's the first one that gives me real stability without the arch bothering me after two hours.
items.author: Miguel Á. F.

items.quote: The 3D foot model I ordered for my Podiatry dissertation is incredibly detailed. It arrived well packaged and on time. I used it in my presentation and the professors asked where I got it.
items.author: Claudia R.

items.quote: I'm a teacher and spend six hours a day moving around the classroom. Since using BIOMSTEP I notice far less lumbar tension by end of day. I didn't expect insoles to have that much impact on my back.
items.author: Sofía L.

items.quote: I asked for advice before buying and they guided me based on my gait and activity type. That level of care isn't something you find in a general retailer. The insoles arrived in two days.
items.author: Roberto M.

faq.title: Quick FAQ
faq.description: Answers to the most common questions before you buy.

items.question: How do I choose the right insole?
items.answer: Pick a category based on your use (sport, work, everyday, or kids). Each product page includes details and recommendations. For clinical questions, consult your podiatrist.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: We process orders within 1–2 business days. You'll receive tracking by email once your order leaves our warehouse.

items.question: Can I return a product?
items.answer: Yes, you have 14 days to return unused, non-customized products. See our returns policy for details.

items.question: Are anatomical models for clinical use?
items.answer: They are intended as visual and educational aids. They do not replace individual diagnosis or surgical planning.
